# Pinned logging v6 producer fixtures

Synthetic, deterministic JSON Lines generated through the production runtime
projectors and persistence encoder. They are not native execution receipts.
`manifest.json` identifies the producer, generator, schema and fixture profile;
each stream includes its row count and SHA256. Studio admits schema v6 only;
historical fixture directories remain provenance and exclusion-test inputs.

The streams are independent synthetic contract examples, not a single reconciled
job/session ledger. Native row/state/attempt reconciliation is verified separately
by the simulator and integration tests.

Regenerate at the producer checkout, then deliberately update this pinned copy
and the packaged analytics schema together:

```powershell
..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe tests/fixtures/logging/v6/generator.py tests/fixtures/logging/v6
..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/unit/logging/test_logging_v6.py -n 0 -o addopts='' -q
```

`schema.json` validates each job/dataflow/system record. Snapshot and batch
streams cover typed bounds/candidates, source-empty and no-attempt observations,
retry-success, transformed-empty writes, maintenance, replay early outcomes and
terminal chunks, sparse/known-zero metrics, failed optional capture, an adapter
exception after a physical write, and bounded root/attempt/phase diagnostics.
There is no persisted outer replay aggregate row. See
the producer's `docs/reference/concepts/logging.md` for the contract.

`job_bounded_snapshot.json` is generated by an actual small-budget logger/writer:
the oversized dataflow record is dropped but the failed-run job summary survives.
